name: Jungle Grid
desc: Submit async compute jobs, monitor status and logs, and retrieve artifacts from Jungle Grid.

actions.name: estimate_job
actions.description: Estimate the cost, duration, and resources for a Jungle Grid job.

actions.name: submit_job
actions.description: Submit a Jungle Grid job and return immediately with job metadata. This action does not wait for completion.

actions.name: list_jobs
actions.description: List Jungle Grid jobs for the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by status.

actions.name: get_job_status
actions.description: Get the current status and metadata for a submitted Jungle Grid job.

actions.name: get_job_runtime
actions.description: Get runtime tails, exit code, and runtime availability details for a Jungle Grid job.

actions.name: get_job_logs
actions.description: Get recent stdout, stderr, or combined logs for a submitted Jungle Grid job.

actions.name: list_artifacts
actions.description: List files produced by a Jungle Grid job when managed artifact storage is available.

actions.name: get_artifact_download_url
actions.description: Create a temporary signed download URL for a Jungle Grid artifact. Treat the returned URL as a secret.

actions.name: cancel_job
actions.description: Cancel a non-terminal Jungle Grid job. This may stop active execution.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
